Frequently asked questions

Can't find the right answer here? Visit our FAQ

How is Biograph different from a regular doctor or a concierge medical practice?

Biograph doesn’t replace your primary care physician (PCP). Instead, it complements traditional healthcare by focusing on advanced diagnostics and prevention. While your PCP and/or concierge doctor manages your general health, Biograph provides a comprehensive, data-driven evaluation that detects risks before symptoms appear. 

After your assessment, our medical team synthesizes all of your test results into an easy-to-understand report that highlights your most important health risks and actionable recommendations to address them. 

You’ll review your results one-on-one with a Biograph physician, ensuring you fully understand your health insights and next steps. Additionally, you will have consultations with a Registered Dietitian and Exercise Physiologist to provide personalized guidance on optimizing your long-term health. You can share your report with your doctor, allowing them to integrate Biograph’s insights into your broader care plan.

Where are Biograph’s clinics located?

Biograph’s clinics are located in the San Francisco Bay Area (2850 S Delaware St Suite 100, San Mateo, CA 94403) and New York City (27 Park Row, New York, NY 10038), both in easily accessible locations near major airports.

What if I need to travel for my Biograph visit?

More than half of Biograph members travel from out of town to visit our clinics. Travel is only required once for your clinic visit. All follow-up consultations are virtual. If you are a Black tier member, all additional services including six-month lab draw, CGM, and sleep testing are done at home. Some services will need to be adjusted if you live outside of the US.

Our team is experienced in helping members coordinate their travel plans and making the process seamless. Email info@biograph.com or book a call with our team, and we will be happy to assist with logistics to make your visit as smooth as possible.

What health assessments are included in my Biograph evaluation?

Biograph offers up to 30+ advanced assessments, providing a comprehensive picture of your health through cutting-edge diagnostics. The specific assessments included depend on your membership tier. Core Membership includes 20+ assessments, covering essential diagnostics such as Whole-Body MRI, VO2 Max testing, Genetic Testing, and DEXA Body Composition Analysis. 

Black Membership expands the evaluation to 30+ assessments, adding advanced screenings like CT Coronary Angiography, Multi-Cancer Early Detection Testing, and Multi-Modal Brain Health Assessments. Both tiers provide personalized, data-driven insights designed to help you proactively manage your health, detect risks early, and optimize longevity.

What percentage of members receive concerning findings? 

Since opening our first clinic in the San Francisco Bay Area, more than 15% of Biograph members have discovered urgent or life-altering health insights—including early-stage cancer, cardiovascular disease, and neurodegenerative conditions. 

When concerning findings arise, our team actively supports members in securing the best follow-up care as quickly as possible, ensuring they receive expert guidance and next steps. Biograph is committed to actionable diagnostics—we only run tests that provide clinically validated, meaningful insights, so every assessment empowers you to make informed, proactive decisions about your health.

If my results show something concerning, what happens next?

If any concerning findings are detected, one of Biograph’s doctors will reach out to you right away and provide a clear and detailed explanation of your results. Our team will guide you through the next steps, ensuring that you understand the severity of the findings and your options for further evaluation or treatment. 

We also facilitate referrals to top specialists, both locally and internationally, and provide ongoing support to help you navigate the next phase of your health journey.
